# Alfayad Shameer

Alfayad Shameer is a full-stack developer and UI/UX designer based in Alappuzha, Kerala, India. His portfolio is https://alfayad.clawdage.com.

## Work

- Codeteak (https://codeteak.com), Bengaluru and Dubai. Software engineer. He designs the interface and builds the web and mobile products with the team. Started April 2025.
- Freelance full-stack product work, remote, from Alappuzha. Includes APIs and payments.
- Brototype internship, MERN stack, January 2024 to December 2025.

He is open for freelance work. Email alfayadshameer056@gmail.com or book at https://hirefayad.vercel.app.

## What he builds

Web apps, mobile apps, and AI products. Stack: JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, Express, NestJS, MongoDB, PostgreSQL, Tailwind CSS, and AI integration.

## Projects

- FAYAD AI, a personal AI assistant: https://fayad-ai.vercel.app
- TraceX, an expense tracking app: https://tracexx.vercel.app
- Yaadro, supermarket delivery management for the UAE: https://yaadro.ae
